scope: Method recommendation for the accepted 120-issuer source diagnostic; no actual selection or production admission.

preserved_law.vendor_blinding: Freeze policy, frame, selection and manual annotation before relationship-vendor outputs.

recommendation.rationale: Size diversity relative to each diagnostic market/activity is more suitable for a source-disclosure diagnostic with fixed geographic and activity quotas. Preserve full USD values and absolute bands for cross-market interpretation.
recommendation.critical_qualification: L/M/S become relative sampling slots. They do not certify global large/mid/small-cap status. This meaning requires explicit principal adoption.
recommendation.absolute_band_usage: Companion descriptive column and alternative-policy feasibility certificate, never a silent replacement for the chosen relative slots.
recommendation.reject_if: Principal requires constant economic size across markets, cannot lawfully complete the rank frame, or declines the explicit size-meaning change.

A_GLOBAL_ABSOLUTE_USD.market_cap_measure: same reported-share reference capitalization as B
A_GLOBAL_ABSOLUTE_USD.failure: Any US/CN/HK/CA sector-size count below2/1/1, or INT max flow below24, is infeasible. No Canada-only lower threshold.

C_WITHIN_JURISDICTION_ALL_ACTIVITY_RANKS.boundaries: Same count-band formula, pooling the six in-scope activity groups within each jurisdiction group
C_WITHIN_JURISDICTION_ALL_ACTIVITY_RANKS.reason: Does not ensure sector-size availability and changes an activity's size label when unrelated activities enter the frame.

D_MSCI_STYLE_COVERAGE.reason: Cumulative investable capitalization, free-float inputs, global bounds and index maintenance solve an investability problem. They add data dependencies and do not ensure sector quotas.

cutoff_policy.rule: Use only source assertions with defensible public-availability upper bound at or before the cutoff and applicable fact validity at valuation date. Later publications are excluded even if they describe an earlier period.
cutoff_policy.native_freeze_requirement: Principal receipt must bind the actual later freeze F, all actual observation/acquisition timestamps and bytes, policy adoption, and vendor-blind status. F must precede any vendor-output consumption. Never fabricate historical observed_at.
cutoff_policy.temporal_claim: Retrospective month-end reference-size diagnostic, publicly knowable by K and assembled at F. Not a tradable point-in-time universe at D or evidence that Mastermind held inputs at K.
cutoff_policy.date_only_publication: Use the end of the stated publication day in the source's documented timezone as the availability upper bound. Unknown timezone or date-only bound crossing K remains unknown.
cutoff_policy.revisions: Order eligible observations by the component's measurement/validity rule first. Same-fact/date/basis assertions are revisions only with proved supersession under capitalization.assertion_resolution; publication or acquisition recency alone never resolves disagreement. All assertions and relation evidence used must be publicly available by K.
cutoff_policy.classification_document_rule: Most recent primary annual report/prospectus applicable at D and available by K may supply frame metadata. This metadata source does not expand the accepted 2023–2025 annual relationship-diagnostic corpus.
cutoff_policy.historical_roster: Every contributing venue/segment requires historical_frame proof of D membership. A later current directory plus valid intervals on surviving rows does not establish D population completeness.
cutoff_policy.D_conditioned_inference_limit: The2023–2025document diagnostic is conditioned on membership at D; even a complete D frame is not every earlier fiscal year's issuer population.

instrument_and_venue.venue_rule: Issuer-applied primary ordinary-equity admission on a lawfully operating national equity exchange or recognized equity growth market in the stated jurisdiction, open beyond professional-investor-exclusive admissions. Trading-only venues and secondary listings do not establish primary eligibility.
instrument_and_venue.venue_register_requirement: Require historical_frame.perimeter_closure and a historical-D membership receipt for every in-scope venue/segment/instrument partition, including ones that qualified at D but later closed or changed. Current registration and survivor-row validity are insufficient; FRAME_HISTORY_UNPROVEN blocks affected quantiles.

US.authority_route: SEC6(a) status plus exchange primary-equity admission rules;6(g) futures-only is excluded

CN_MAINLAND.authority_route: CSRC and Shanghai/Shenzhen/Beijing ordinary-equity admission records, including qualified-retail growth boards; no NEEQ/OTC substitution

HK.authority_route: SEHK Main Board/GEM primary or dual-primary records; secondary-only does not qualify

CA.authority_route: Canadian recognition and issuer-admission records, including eligible TSX/TSXV/CSE/Cboe Canada markets, not trading-only status

UK.authority_route: FCA/UK venue and issuer-admission records including qualifying Main/growth admissions; not the Official List alone

JP.authority_route: FSA plus Japanese exchange primary-equity admission records; do not restrict silently to TSE or to its Prime segment

EU.authority_route: National regulator/ESMA RM or eligible primary-admission equity-growth MTF records; EEA outsideEU, UK and Switzerland excluded

instrument_and_venue.new_venue_or_perimeter_change: Requires new policy/frame version before vendor unblinding; no ad hoc venue addition to rescue a cell.

identity_and_primary.issuer_unit: Incumbent owner-resolved economic issuer / listed consolidated reporting entity; use canonical IDs and validity evidence, never ticker count.
identity_and_primary.unresolved_identity: NO_ISSUER_EVIDENCE, ambiguous economic-unit mappings and null identifiers remain unresolved. Null values are not a deduplicated issuer.
identity_and_primary.parent_subsidiary: Distinct independently listed/reporting legal issuers may remain distinct with a controlled-family flag. Do not merge them just because of common control; unresolved dual-listed-company economic units go to the identity owner.
identity_and_primary.primary_status_evidence: Exchange/issuer admission, listing conversion or continued-status evidence applicable at D and available by K. Domicile, CIK, ticker suffix, traded volume and ADR status alone are insufficient.
identity_and_primary.unique_primary: Use the unique proved eligible primary jurisdiction group.
identity_and_primary.multiple_primary: Deduplicate primary jurisdiction groups. Choose the group with minimum H('primary-jurisdiction', issuer_id, group_id). This is an administrative sampling assignment, not a claim of sole legal primary status. Preserve every primary and secondary coordinate.
identity_and_primary.multiple_countries_within_EU: Choose minimum H('primary-country', issuer_id, ISO_country) among proved EU primaries for reporting; this does not create extra EU country quotas.
identity_and_primary.no_proved_eligible_primary: Exclude if proved primary scope is outside the perimeter; otherwise hold as PRIMARY_UNKNOWN. Do not allocate to the most convenient quota.

capitalization.name: ISSUER_REPORTED_SHARE_REFERENCE_CAPITALIZATION_USD
capitalization.intended_construct: Total residual ordinary-equity issuer value; not free float, fully diluted equity, enterprise value or exact unobserved shares outstanding at D.
capitalization.formula: V_i = sum over unique ordinary economic share classes j of Q_j_ref(D,K) * P_j_ref(D,K) * quote_unit_scale_j * USD_per_quote_currency(D,K).

share_count.source: Choose the greatest eligible actual share-count measurement date<=D from the bound permitted assertion set, within183calendar days; publication/observation recency does not choose the measurement. Resolve same-fact/date/class/basis assertions by assertion_resolution. A conflicted latest required measurement cannot fall back to an older clean count.
share_count.bridge: Apply quantitatively disclosed issuance, retirement, split, conversion and treasury changes effective after count date through D and publicly available by K, once each. Missing quantities for a known material action hold the cap.
share_count.state: Disclosed-action reference estimate. Undisclosed buybacks/issuances are not claimed observed; retain share-count date, age and bridge limitations.

prices.source: Use the prebound class/counter/MIC and latest allowed official session at/before D, within both age bounds. Resolve competing assertions for that exact session/counter/raw-close basis; a later publication is not automatically a winner.
prices.historical_adjustment: Retain raw source close and explicit source-backed factor bridges for share-unit or quote-unit transformations between its session and D. Price and shares must have compatible D-equivalent units. A stale pre-split close needs the inverse price factor when used with post-split shares. No silent vendor-adjusted price or unbound factor.
prices.stale_or_suspended: Retain flags; beyond either age bound or without a lawful price the value is unknown, never zero.
prices.reference_line_tie: For the same fungible class, use its source-designated primary reference counter. If several equally primary counters exist, use ascending MIC bytes then stable security_id bytes, fixed before values are examined.

share_class_and_ADR.multi_class: Sum separately outstanding non-fungible ordinary classes once each using their own bound prices. A/H classes require class-specific counts/prices/currencies.
share_class_and_ADR.same_class_cross_listing: Choose one price coordinate; do not sum the same underlying share class across exchanges.
share_class_and_ADR.ADR: With r underlying ordinary shares per ADR, ordinary-equivalent price is ADR_price/r. Verify r at D. Deposited ordinary shares are already part of Q and are not added a second time.
share_class_and_ADR.unlisted_class_proxy: Permitted only for source-proved identical residual economic rights and a documented fixed conversion ratio into a priced ordinary class; bind proxy and ratio. Otherwise UNPRICED_ECONOMIC_CLASS holds the entire issuer value.
share_class_and_ADR.assertion_rule: Rights, class identity and ADR/conversion ratios are source-bound state assertions. Incompatible states applicable at D need proved transition/supersession; later publication or a later asserted start date alone cannot settle them.

fx.series: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates
fx.common_rate_date: D if published; otherwise the latest published reference date<=D, at most5calendar days earlier. One common ECB date for all required currencies.
fx.quote_unit: Use a separately bound price denomination multiplier, e.g.GBp to GBP=1/100 only where the source identifies pence.
fx.assertion_rule: Select the prescribed ECB series/reference date first. Same-pair/date/quote-basis conflicts require proved supersession; retain mirror lineage. A different provider/series is outside this fixed policy, not a fallback winner.

capitalization.numeric_rule: Parse finite positive decimal inputs into exact rationals; apply exact source ratios. Compare/rank unrounded rational USD values. Display rounding cannot decide eligibility.
capitalization.cap_unknown_handling: Missing/unavailable/conflicting/basis-unproved required components leave issuer reference cap null. If the issuer could be eligible, CAP_FRAME_INCOMPLETE holds pool quantiles, retaining CAP_COMPONENT_CONFLICT/BASIS_UNPROVEN as the precise cause.

assertion_resolution.permitted_assertion_set: The prebound source-component plan and complete retained bundle define the audited assertion scope. Preserve all encountered competing assertions in that scope, including mirrors/lineage. Do not filter disagreement away. No claim is made about every possible assertion outside that search scope.

identities.owner_identity: Issuer/class/event identities require incumbent resolution evidence; this recommendation creates no actual IDs.
identities.conflict_key: Publisher, publication and observation identity are excluded from the economic conflict key. Independent sources about the same fact/date/basis must enter the same comparison set.
identities.mirror_rule: A mirror/republication may repeat one upstream assertion; retain that lineage rather than calling it independent agreement.

component_keys.OUTSTANDING_SHARES: Issuer + economic ordinary class + actual measurement date + outstanding/treasury basis + normalized units. Float, weighted-average EPS and fully diluted counts are different/ineligible bases.
component_keys.REFERENCE_CLOSE: Class/security + prebound MIC/counter + official session + raw regular-close basis + quote currency/denomination. Different venues/adjusted series are not interchangeable.
component_keys.ADR_OR_CONVERSION_RATIO: Underlying and receipt/other class + ratio direction + applicability at D + economic-rights basis.
component_keys.ORDINARY_CLASS_RIGHTS: Issuer/class pair + residual-rights/equivalence assertion + applicable validity interval.
component_keys.CORPORATE_ACTION_DELTA: Resolved economic event + affected class + effective coordinate + action type + signed quantity/factor basis. Unresolved duplicate-event identity cannot be summed twice.
component_keys.QUOTE_UNIT_SCALE: Price coordinate + documented denomination + currency-unit basis + applicable interval.
component_keys.FX_REFERENCE_RATE: Prescribed ECB series + currency pair + reference date + quote direction/basis, regardless of mirrors.

admissibility_and_order: Verify actual source/derivation bytes and authority, permitted use, issuer/class/event identity, valid-time applicability, actual-versus-estimated eligibility and publication upper bound<=K.
Normalize units/ratios only with proved conversion evidence. Ambiguous identity/basis/applicability yields CAP_COMPONENT_BASIS_UNPROVEN, not assumed comparability.
For point measurements choose the greatest allowed measurement/session/reference date under the fixed component rule before considering publication recency; keep earlier dates separate.
For persistent rights/ratio/state facts require a source-proved state or transition applicable at D. Overlapping incompatible states conflict even if assertion start dates differ.

For each required fact/date/basis, eliminate only assertions proved superseded within that fact scope. Retain the full assertion/revision graph; no unexplained publisher hierarchy or newest-publication rule.
Equivalent exact normalized values may resolve to one value with all provenance retained. Distinct unreconciled active values yield CAP_COMPONENT_CONFLICT.
A required unresolved/conflicting component or dependency holds the entire issuer cap and its reference pool. Never average assertions, take partial-class cap or choose by quota fit/hash.

An older-date conflict outside the selected dependency closure remains recorded, not corrected by a newer distinct measurement. A conflict at the latest required measurement cannot fall back to an earlier clean date.

sufficient_evidence: publisher correction/restatement identifying the affected prior assertion/fact and its replacement
publisher-established authoritative revision protocol plus exact versions/fact scope proving replacement
primary-evidence reconciliation of units/basis/identity or upstream lineage, with accountable owner record
supersession.rule: Relations must be source-backed, applicable, acyclic, within K and limited to the fact scope proved; all referenced assertions/bytes must exist. Cross-source disagreement persists unless each competitor is reconciled/retracted or shown to repeat the superseded source.
supersession.retraction_without_replacement: If a proved retraction leaves no admissible value, return unavailable; do not impute a replacement.
supersession.reconciliation_is_not_automatic_superses: Unit/basis distinctions and upstream alias relations are recorded as those relation types. They are not correction edges unless actual replacement is independently proved; no active competitor is removed merely by calling a reconciliation a revision.

resolution_receipt.unresolved_rule: All non-resolved states retain null resolved value, all competing assertions and typed reasons. Digest-shaped fields alone do not prove resolution.

dependency_and_unit_closure.share_bridge: Every needed material disclosed count-to-D action needs resolved event identity, numeric effect, effective order and source assertions.
dependency_and_unit_closure.price_share_bridge: Source raw price and selected shares must use compatible D-equivalent share units. A proved2-for-1 split requires old raw per-share price/2 when paired with doubled shares. Unknown/conflicting factors produce CAP_COMPONENT_BASIS_UNPROVEN.
dependency_and_unit_closure.proxy: Unlisted-class proxy depends on resolved residual rights, conversion ratio and listed-class price; a conflict in any dependency holds the full issuer cap.

activity_assignment.target: Own single diagnostic activity-group label, not a fabricated GICS/SIC/ICB code.
evidence_routes: A lawful, dated issuer-level classification from a regulator/exchange or entitled classification owner, with a frozen one-to-one crosswalk to this activity definition.

Primary issuer annual/prospectus business and external-revenue evidence: map disjoint business activities to groups and assign the sole group with >50% of consolidated external annual revenue. No mixed denominator, intersegment double count or companywide allocation to a minority theme.

reference_code_hints.SEMICONDUCTOR_CLOUD: GICS45301010 or45301020 only if supplied lawfully for the issuer at the relevant vintage; broad45 is insufficient. IaaS/PaaS operators require direct activity proof.
reference_code_hints.INDUSTRIALS: GICS20 if actually supplied lawfully and applicable
reference_code_hints.CONSUMER: GICS25 or30 if actually supplied lawfully and applicable
reference_code_hints.ENERGY_MATERIALS: GICS10 or15 if actually supplied lawfully and applicable
reference_code_hints.FINANCIALS: GICS40 if actually supplied lawfully and applicable
reference_code_hints.HEALTHCARE: GICS35 if actually supplied lawfully and applicable

SEMICONDUCTOR_CLOUD.included: Semiconductor device design/manufacture/foundry/assembly-test and semiconductor-production equipment; external IaaS/PaaS cloud operators.
SEMICONDUCTOR_CLOUD.excluded: Generic IT, a cloud customer, internal IT, generic SaaS alone, property-only data-center landlord, a minority cloud/AI narrative. Hardware outside semiconductor activity needs its own group proof.
SEMICONDUCTOR_CLOUD.cloud_test: Primary descriptions must substantiate external IaaS/PaaS operation under NIST service-model distinctions and the business-majority or authoritative classification route; no reported revenue split may be invented.

INDUSTRIALS.included: Capital goods, industrial production/services and transport/logistics primary activities within the frozen group crosswalk.
INDUSTRIALS.excluded: Activity allocated to semiconductor production, energy/materials, utilities or pure real-estate ownership.

CONSUMER.included: Consumer discretionary/staples primary activities, including consumer retail, food, household goods, automobiles and leisure under the frozen crosswalk.
CONSUMER.excluded: Financial insurance, healthcare services, generic IT hardware automatically inferred from selling to consumers.

ENERGY_MATERIALS.included: Energy extraction/refining/equipment and basic materials/mining/chemicals/forestry primary activities under the frozen crosswalk.
ENERGY_MATERIALS.excluded: Regulated utilities automatically reclassified to fill a slot.

FINANCIALS.included: Operating banks, credit, financial services/capital markets and insurance companies.
FINANCIALS.excluded: Passive investment vehicles and managed healthcare merely renamed insurance; use the source-backed activity definition.

HEALTHCARE.included: Healthcare providers/services/managed care, equipment, medicines, biotechnology and life-sciences primary activities.
HEALTHCARE.excluded: Life-and-health financial insurance by name alone, property-only healthcare REITs, recreational consumer products by medical association alone.

activity_assignment.zero_or_pre_revenue: A primary prospectus/annual report may establish one and only one operating activity, with independent reviewer agreement. Otherwise hold. Pre-revenue is not synonymous with a blank-check shell.
activity_assignment.mixed_or_conflicting: If neither route gives a unique applicable group, or authoritative code and direct primary evidence conflict materially, SECTOR_UNRESOLVED/SECTOR_CONFLICT. No thematic inference or quota-driven tie.
activity_assignment.subgroup_scope_change: Changing the narrow cloud operator rule or excluded sectors is a policy amendment, not an implementation convenience.

relative_size.international_rule: Rank UK, JP and EU separately by activity, then combine their labelled candidates for INT quota solving. Do not impose four issuers per country/activity; only INT totals and8/8/8 are law.
relative_size.denominator: Every eligible economic issuer in the historically proved D perimeter after canonical identity and fixed administrative primary-jurisdiction assignment; not current survivors, all trading lines, selected issuers or vendor/nonmissing subsets.
relative_size.completeness: Require historical_frame HISTORY_PROVEN for every contributing partition, then issuer/primary/activity/cap completeness. Every D member must resolve to an eligible unique issuer or evidenced exclusion. FRAME_HISTORY_UNPROVEN and any potentially eligible unresolved row/component hold affected quantiles.

rule.N: Number of eligible, uniquely resolved, valid-cap issuers in the complete pool.
rule.tie_rule: Never split identical reference-cap values across bands. Equal-valued boundary blocks move together to the higher band. Empty middle/lower bands can make the design infeasible.
rule.small_N: N<4 cannot satisfy a non-INT sector quota. In an INT country/activity pool smallN may supply some bands; the joint solver decides global feasibility.

relative_size.administrative_population_label: These ranks concern the assigned, deduplicated primary-jurisdiction frame, not every company with any listing in that jurisdiction.

deterministic_selection.encoding: H(domain,*fields)=SHA256(concat(uint64_big_endian(len(UTF8(s))) || UTF8(s) for s in [domain,seed,*fields])). Strict UTF8, no trimming/case-folding/Unicode normalization of owner canonical identifiers.
deterministic_selection.issuer_priority: Ascending H('issuer-priority',issuer_id), then exact UTF8 issuer_id bytes on a digest collision.
deterministic_selection.non_INT: For each of4strata x6activities x3bands, require capacity>=quota and choose the first quota issuers by issuer_priority.

INT_feasibility.country_to_sector_band: Capacity equals number of eligible unique candidates in that country/activity/band.
INT_feasibility.sector_band_to_sink: Capacity q_band (L2,M1,S1) for each of18activity-band nodes.
INT_feasibility.certificate: Record all integer capacities, achieved maxflow and a deficient mincut if flow<24. All source/sink capacities total24, so fullflow saturates every quota.
INT_feasibility.deterministic_solution: Use the residual procedure below. Remove the current candidate before trial flow; subtract its incidence once; require nonnegative residual quotas and flow equal to their remaining total, not24. Commit only feasible inclusions. This returns the lexicographically smallest sorted selected-priority list.
residual_pseudocode: For candidate c in fixed issuer-priority order:
Remove c from remaining BEFORE any tentative inclusion test.
If any trial quota is negative: exclude c with reason; continue.
Require sum(trial_country)==sum(trial_cell); target:=that common nonnegative residual sum.
If flow==target: append c; adopt both trial quota vectors.
Else: exclude c; retain existing quotas and deficient residual capacity/mincut evidence.
Require24unique selected issuer IDs and all remaining quotas0.
implementation_test_requirements: Tentative candidate cannot satisfy its own residual demand.
Residual target decreases after inclusions; it is not fixed24.
Compare small synthetic instances with exhaustive feasible subsets.
Permutation does not change selected priority list.
Reject duplicate issuer identity before aggregation.
Retain deficient cuts without reclassifying candidates.

deterministic_selection.inference_limit: Deterministic quota diagnostic; not a probability sample of global issuers and not a population-weighted performance estimate.
preflight_order: Verify exact adopted policy/corrective-review/input bindings and authority_boundary states. Structural kernel success is not authenticated completeness or use rights; pending trust/adoption gates cannot select the real120cohort.
Prove historical perimeter and per-venue D membership closure.
Resolve incumbent identity, fixed primary-jurisdiction assignment and primary-company activity at D/K.
Resolve required cap assertions, supersession/conflicts, temporal/units basis and source-use scope.
Require completeness of all42reference pools; any held pool returns typed NOT_READY.
Compute unchanged relative thresholds/ties and absolute tags.
Require non-INT capacities and initial INT maxflow24.
Run fixed-priority selection with explicit residual targets and verify120distinct IDs plus every quota.

replacement_law.before_freeze: Correct proved identity, units, status or metadata errors using only eligibility information available by K. Preserve every prior frame/version and recompute with the same policy/seed; no parameter tuning to results.
replacement_law.after_selection_before_vendor_unblinding: An objective eligibility correction requires an independently reviewed superseding freeze and full constrained recomputation from the corrected frame under unchanged cutoffs/seed. Preserve both cohorts and reasons.
replacement_law.after_vendor_unblinding: Do not replace issuers in the registered headline cohort. Retain original requested120 denominator and separately report corrected eligibility. A new cohort requires a new explicit study; never erase the original failure.

stress_case_law.selection: Identify genuine cases within selected issuers and eligible documents before vendor consumption, retain deterministic issuer/document/locator ordering and independent adjudication.
stress_case_law.shortfall: Report measured shortfall; do not replace issuers or fabricate a case. Any outside-cohort challenge supplement must be separately adopted and separately denominated.

no_silent_relaxation: No retie to fill a geography
No reseeding after viewing the cohort
diagnostic_falsifiers: If the intended research claim requires equal dollar scale, relative labels are invalid for that claim even if counts pass.
If all selected relativeL/M/S names in a market share one absolute USD band, report that fact; count balance is not absolute-size diversity.
If a plausible proved share-count/ratio/currency correction changes an assigned band, preserve the failure and follow the correction law.
If the complete Canadahealthcare pool cannot supply2/1/1 under the adopted rule, preserve the shortfall rather than naming unproved issuers.
If individual INT cell counts pass but maxflow<24, the jointly constrained120 design still fails.
If the rank frame cannot be completed lawfully, do not publish eligible-subset quantiles as market-relative ranks.
If fewer than6 genuine stress cases exist in a stratum, the difficult-case acceptance requirement remains unmet.
A later directory omitting a post-D delisting cannot pass historical completeness through surviving-row validity.
Independent same-fact/date/basis disagreement is not resolved by later publication alone.
A stale pre-action price and post-action share count require a proved unit bridge.
Primary-company cohort coverage cannot be presented as complete segment-role coverage.
failure_and_falsifier_law.review_change_triggers: Policy is revised only by principal adoption of a new version with rationale, before vendor outputs for the new study; a failed diagnostic is retained.

scope_of_this_artifact.current_effects: Scratch-only versioned policy correction; frozen v1/frame/review preserved.
scope_of_this_artifact.executable_selector: Not built or run. Separate synthetic counterexample/specification controls may run; no real issuer frame, capitalization census or INT solution.
scope_of_this_artifact.previous_failures_preserved: The initial two-P2 REQUEST_CHANGES review remains unchanged. This author correction is not a corrective PASS.

proposed_semantic_adoptions.current_law: Two large, one mid and one small per stratum/activity; numeric meaning unspecified.
proposed_semantic_adoptions.proposed: Use labelled upper-half/next-quarter/lower-quarter count bands within US,CN_MAINLAND,HK,CA,UK,JP,EU activity pools; allow positive-valued microcaps in relative slots, with absolute USD tags alongside.

proposed_semantic_adoptions.current_law: Six named groups and primary-listing strata; exact crosswalk/perimeter unspecified.
proposed_semantic_adoptions.proposed: Use the explicit single-activity routes, narrow IaaS/PaaS cloud-operator scope, public operating-equity/growth-market perimeter and objective exclusions in this JSON.

proposed_semantic_adoptions.current_law: Freeze size/date/identity/availability before vendor outputs; detailed measurement unspecified.
proposed_semantic_adoptions.proposed: Use reported-share reference issuer cap,183-day maximum share-count age,5-session/10-day price bounds,common ECB FX date, D2026-09-30/K2026-10-09T00:00Z and actual later evidence freezeF.

version_provenance.principal_instruction: R1/R2 accepted for correction preparation; not policy adoption or corrective-review PASS.

historical_frame.purpose: Prove historical population closure before affected-pool quantiles, separately from row eligibility.

perimeter_closure.rule: The venue perimeter itself must be historical at D, including subsequently closed venues, discontinued segments and transferred listing businesses. Every possibly in-scope partition is present or has evidenced exclusion; a list of currently operating venues is insufficient.
perimeter_closure.failure: Unproved historical venue coverage or an unresolved possibly in-scope partition yields FRAME_HISTORY_UNPROVEN for all activity pools it could affect.

target_membership_coordinate.semantics: Use the venue's documented close-of-business membership convention for local D. Bind the UTC instant/timezone or documented end-of-day date semantics; do not invent an exchange time.
target_membership_coordinate.failure: If ambiguous boundary timing could change membership and source evidence does not resolve it, FRAME_HISTORY_UNPROVEN.

input_bindings.verification: Verify actual permitted retained bytes, lengths, derivation and authority bindings. SHA-shaped text, an owner boolean, filename or code existence alone does not establish completeness. Web renderings are not original raw bytes.

HISTORICAL_D_SNAPSHOT.rule: Complete source roster asserted at the target D membership coordinate; retain and check every export/page in the declared partition.
required_closure_evidence: otherwise documented exhaustive export/pagination closure with accountable derived total
all page/partition bindings and terminal-cursor or complete-export evidence
all known omissions and inaccessible partitions
insufficient: valid D intervals on surviving rows
all returned rows processed without complete partition closure

ANCHORED_MEMBERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTION.anchor_rule: A complete roster at proved A with the same partition basis, plus complete membership-state events between A and D. A may precede or follow D, but all source assertions and reconstruction relations must satisfy K.
ANCHORED_MEMBERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTION.coverage: Cover (min(A,D),max(A,D)] at the declared membership boundary. Include admissions, removals, transfers, instrument conversions, source-security identity replacements and primary-status changes. Separate identity/activity validity evidence is still required.
ANCHORED_MEMBERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTION.event_payload: Each transition binds enough before/after state to apply or reverse exactly, a resolved economic event identity, effective ordering, affected source-security IDs and partition coordinates. Names/dates alone cannot restore omitted rows.
ANCHORED_MEMBERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTION.forward_rule: A<D: apply every event over (A,D] in proved order, validating each before state.
ANCHORED_MEMBERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTION.reverse_rule: A>D: reverse every event over (D,A] in reverse proved order, validating each after state. Restore post-D removals, remove post-D admissions, reverse transfers/conversions/status changes, and never filter by current active status.
ANCHORED_MEMBERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTION.failures: Missing event kinds/intervals, ambiguous same-time ordering, incomplete prior states, unresolved event identity/revision or non-reconciling transitions yield FRAME_HISTORY_UNPROVEN.
ANCHORED_MEMBERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTION.K_rule: A post-K current anchor/event does not become admissible merely because it permits a plausible D reconstruction. A different cutoff requires separate adoption.

reconciliation.exact_sets: Reconcile membership sets and each event's before/after state, not totals alone. Cross-listed/security lines resolve through incumbent issuer identities before issuer counting.
reconciliation.missing_source_total: Mark NOT_PUBLISHED, not zero; an evidenced exhaustive source closure plus accountable derived total is still mandatory.
reconciliation.history_pass: Every required partition/event reconciles, with no unexplained missing/extra row or uncovered interval; potentially eligible history omissions and unresolved history are proved zero. An empty partition requires positive completeness evidence.
reconciliation.typed_counts: Required produced counts are nonnegative integers, not booleans; unknown/null is never coerced to zero.
reconciliation.entitlement: Bind permitted historical access, retention, derivation, review sharing and intended downstream distribution. Unentitled/inaccessible potentially eligible rows are omissions, not an excluded population.

readiness.history_state: HISTORY_PROVEN only after binding, coverage, ordering, exact-set reconciliation and entitlement checks. Otherwise FRAME_HISTORY_UNPROVEN, with SOURCE_USE_NOT_ENTITLED also retained where applicable.
readiness.post_history: HISTORY_PROVEN does not resolve issuer identity, primary listing, activity, capitalization or source-document availability; each keeps its separate gate.
readiness.affected_pools: If a held partition may contribute to a group, hold that pool. Unknown activity means all six associated jurisdiction pools are affected.
readiness.quantiles: No affected quantile before its historical and eligibility/cap gates pass. Full120selection remains blocked by any required held pool.

frame_sourcing_dependency.required_scope: Historical venue/segment closure, owner-resolved issuer/primary/activity status and lawful resolved capitalization inputs for all eligible members of all42reference pools, including unselected issuers.
frame_sourcing_dependency.owner_preservation: Existing source/Data OS/identity/classification owners supply their accountable receipts; the selector validates them and cannot manufacture owner facts.
frame_sourcing_dependency.rule: Only complete pools may emit descriptive quantiles. Full120selection requires all42required pools and all quota constraints to be ready; otherwise return typed NOT_READY with measured deficits and explicit unknowns.

coverage_axes.scientific_limit: D membership conditions the2023–2025document sample. Equal quota counts and distinct parent/subsidiary IDs do not establish statistical independence or historical population representation.

authority_boundary.purpose: Separate receipt/kernel coherence from authenticated completeness and use rights.
authority_boundary.structure_only: Parsing a coherent receipt, matching its self-declared hashes, running a correct kernel or passing synthetic fixtures establishes at most STRUCTURAL_ONLY. It cannot establish publisher authority, historical source closure or permission to use/distribute the source.
authority_boundary.authenticated_scope: HISTORY_PROVEN and resolved real-source component claims require accountable source/coverage/rights decisions authenticated through a principal-approved existing trust path, bound to exact source/derived hashes, D/K, scope and intended use. An untrusted input cannot assert its own verifier result.
authority_boundary.missing_trust: Absent or unverified authority/rights bindings return SOURCE_AUTHORITY_UNVERIFIED and/or SOURCE_RIGHTS_UNVERIFIED; do not mislabel uncertainty as demonstrated lack of a license.
authority_boundary.first_selector_consequential_input_choic: The principal must choose the existing trusted owner-review/admission receipt interface and how its provenance is authenticated. This recommendation does not invent a signature scheme or new authority registry. Until that interface is supplied and verified, the first selector can exercise structural/synthetic behavior but must hold real-source history/admission claims and real120selection.
